title: Nidaa · Lokutan salla, kiran salla da Alƙibla don iPhone da Apple Watch
description: Lokutan salla, kiran salla da Alƙibla a iPhone da Apple Watch. Ana lissafa lokutan salla a cikin wayarku, don haka suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba. Babu asusu, babu talla, babu nazari.

hero.title: Ku ba salla wuri a cikin ranarku
hero.lede: Lokutan salla, kiran salla da Alƙibla a iPhone da Apple Watch. Ana lissafa lokutan salla a cikin wayarku, don haka suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba.

store.qr_alt: Lambar QR: ku duba ta da kyamarar iPhone ɗinku don samun Nidaa a App Store

screens.mosques: Allon Masallatai na Nidaa: masallatai mafi kusa a London, tare da lokacin tafiya a ƙafa, da mota da kuma da sufurin jama'a
screens.today: Allon Yau na Nidaa a London: La'asar nan da awa 2 da minti 11, da ƙarfe 4:53 PM, sannan dukkan salloli biyar da fitowar rana
screens.qibla: Allon Alƙibla ta AR na Nidaa: hanyar kibiyoyi masu launin zinariya a ƙasa da ke kaiwa zuwa Ka'aba, mai nisan 4,794 km

notes.title: Masallatai da ke kusa da ku
notes.text: Lokacin tafiya a ƙafa, da mota da kuma da sufurin jama'a, sannan kwatance a Apple Maps, Google Maps ko Waze.

notes.title: Ƙidaya zuwa salla ta gaba
notes.text: Dukkan salloli biyar da fitowar rana na yau, da sauran lokaci kafin salla ta gaba.

notes.title: Alƙibla ta AR
notes.text: Bi hanyar da ke ƙasa zuwa Ka'aba, ko ku yi amfani da kamfas.

calls.title: Ana kiran ku zuwa kowace salla

chapters.title: Kiran salla a kan lokaci
chapters.text: Zaɓi cikakken kiran salla, ƙararrawa ko shiru ga kowace salla daban.

chapters.title: Kafin lokaci ya fita
chapters.text: Tunatarwa minti 5 zuwa 60 kafin lokacin salla ya fita, don kada shagalin yamma ya sa La'asar ta kuɓuce muku.

chapters.title: Ƙidaya a allon kulle
chapters.text: Live Activity na ƙirga zuwa salla ta gaba a allon kulle da kuma cikin Dynamic Island.

calls.lock_label: Allon kulle na iPhone da ƙarfe 7:30 PM, da ƙidayar Isha'i ta Nidaa da sanarwoyin Magariba guda biyu

wrist.title: A wuyan hannunku
wrist.lede: Sallolin yau, kamfas na Alƙibla da ƙidaya a fuskar agogonku, ta hanyar complications da Smart Stack.

watches.alt: Nidaa a Apple Watch: sallolin yau a London, Isha'i da ƙarfe 5:31 PM da Asubar gobe da ƙarfe 5:58 AM
watches.title: Sallolin yau
watches.text: Dukkan biyar da fitowar rana, tare da alamar salla ta gaba.

watches.alt: Fuskar Apple Watch mai complications na Nidaa: Asuba da ƙarfe 5:58 AM, nan da awa 7 da minti 55
watches.title: A fuskar agogonku
watches.text: Salla ta gaba da ƙidayarta, a cikin complications.

watches.alt: Kamfas na Alƙibla na Nidaa a Apple Watch: 119° daga Arewa, ana fuskantar Alƙibla
watches.title: Alƙibla
watches.text: Kamfas a wuyan hannunku, wanda ke komawa kore idan kun fuskanci Makka.

more.title: Duk abin da kuke buƙata don salloli biyar

items.title: Lokutan salla ba tare da intanet ba
items.text: Ana lissafa lokutan salla da Alƙibla a cikin wayarku. Da zarar an adana wurinku, ba ku buƙatar sigina.

items.title: Lokutan da masallacinku ke bi
items.text: Hanyar lissafi ta ƙasarku, La'asar bisa mazhabar Shafi'i ko Hanafi, da gyaran minti ga kowace salla.

items.title: Wata guda a shafi ɗaya
items.text: Jadawalin wata da za ku iya rabawa ko bugawa a matsayin PDF mai shafi ɗaya.

items.title: Ranakun sunna
items.text: Tunatarwa don Juma'a, Ranakun Farin Wata, Litinin da Alhamis, Arafa, Ashura da sulusin ƙarshe na dare.

items.title: Widget
items.text: Sallolin yau da salla ta gaba a Home Screen da kuma allon kulle.

items.title: Siri da Shortcuts
items.text: Tambayi Siri lokacin salla ta gaba, ko ku saka shi a cikin shortcut.

items.title: Kwanan watan Hijira
items.text: Yana kusa da kwanan watan yau, kuma ana iya gyara shi da kwana ɗaya ko biyu don ya dace da ganin wata a inda kuke.

items.title: Da harshenku
items.text: Harsuna 13, rubutu mafi girma, VoiceOver, da yanayin haske da na duhu.

quiet.title: Nidaa ba ta san komai game da ku ba
quiet.text: Babu asusu, babu talla, babu nazari. Nidaa ba ta tattara komai.
